columns.name: Title
columns.description: The title of the project seeking TIF funding.

columns.name: Requesting Dept.
columns.description: The department or agency requesting the TIF Funding.

columns.name: Improvement Type
columns.description: The category of development seeking TIF funds.

columns.name: Project Address
columns.description: The primary adddress of the project location.

columns.name: Address Details
columns.description: Additional address information or non specified project locations.

columns.name: TIF Dist. (1)
columns.description: The primary TIF district in which the project is receiving funds.

columns.name: TIF Dist. (2)
columns.description: The secondary TIF district in which the project is receiving funds.

columns.name: Ward(s)
columns.description: The ward(s) in wich the project is located.

columns.name: Project Description
columns.description: A brief description of the proposed project that is requesting TIF funding.

columns.name: Current TIF Request
columns.description: The amount of TIF funding that the project is requesting.

columns.name: Total Project Costs
columns.description: The total projected cost of the project requesting TIF funding.

columns.name: Percentage of TIF
columns.description: The share of the total project costs being covered by the requested TIF funding.

columns.name: Final Decision Date
columns.description: The date at which the project was approved.

columns.name: Location
columns.description: The location of the Project Address column, geocoded to a format that allows for mapping and other geographic analysis
